claims: Karpathy's post about his personal knowledge base got 105,000 bookmarks (screen shows 105K bookmarks, 20.1M views, 12K reposts)
The system is 'three folders, one file': raw/, wiki/, outputs/ plus CLAUDE.md as the schema
You never organise anything yourself; the AI reads, links and summarises raw dumps into a wiki
Creator built his version in 45 minutes on a Saturday morning in Claude Cowork
Day 1 it is 'a handful of articles, a few saved answers'; by Day 100 it is 'a company asset nobody else has' (cross-referenced, your sources, your judgement)
how_to_steps: Create three folders: raw/ (junk drawer: articles, notes, transcripts; do not organise), wiki/ (where Claude writes the organised version; you never edit by hand), outputs/ (answers, briefings, reports generated on request)
Write a CLAUDE.md that acts as the schema telling Claude how to process raw/ into wiki/
Dump information into raw/ without organising

Have Claude (in Cowork) run a build pass: select the strongest entries, pull content for each, save entries to raw as markdown, write a wiki INDEX, then write foundational articles (batch 1), method/framework articles (batch 2), and further topic articles (batch 3)
Ask questions and request briefings; answers land in outputs/ and the wiki compounds over time
on_screen_only: Karpathy X post text and stats: 2.4K replies, 12K reposts, 105K bookmarks, 20.1M views

Folder cards: raw/ 'Your junk drawer. Articles, notes, transcripts. Don't organise it.'; wiki/ 'Where Claude writes the organised version. You never edit by hand.'; outputs/ 'Answers, briefings, reports. Generated when you ask.'; CLAUDE.md '— the schema'

Cowork task checklist: 'Select 10-20 strongest entries', 'Pull content for each selected entry', 'Save entries to RAW as markdown', '5 Writing Wiki INDEX', '6 Write foundational articles (batch 1)', '7 Write method/framework articles (batch 2)', '8 Write ... articles (batch 3)' with 'Claude CoWork' label
Claude app tabs: Chat | Cowork | Code

Finder tree 'CoWork-Templated-OS': CoWork OS - First Install Guide.pdf, cowork-os-beta/ (00_START HERE CoWork OS Getting Started.pdf, ABOUT ME, AREAS/_work-areas-guide.md, Admin-PA, Business, Finance, Marketing, Personal, CLAUDE.md, KNOWLEDGE, RESOURCES), Plugin-Marketplace, Skills Source-Dev, template-cowork-os_legacy version, Versions_Archive_Zips

relevance.why: Directly applicable: a markdown-only, Claude-maintained knowledge base with a CLAUDE.md schema is exactly the kind of low-maintenance context store a solo founder running Claude Code/Cowork benefits from; no new paid tools.

implement_score.why: Cheap to try: three folders + a CLAUDE.md + a Cowork/Claude Code 'ingest and wiki-ify' routine. Under an hour to set up; main cost is remembering to dump material in. Could run as a scheduled Claude Code task.
